baslik: A Units Mix-Up Crashed a Mars Spacecraft

sahneler.metin: A spacecraft reached Mars and vanished.
It dove too deep into the atmosphere and was destroyed.
The cause was a units mismatch.
One team's software reported thrust in pound-force seconds.
Each small error pushed the spacecraft slightly off course.
Over months, they added up to a fatal miss.
Now interfaces must state their units and be checked end to end.

aciklama:
Mars Climate Orbiter was lost at Mars. The cause: imperial-to-metric units mismatch in trajectory software.

#shorts #engineering #software
